title: Descent II
prelaunch:
rem ELECTRONIC REGISTRATION CARD. DESCENTW.EXE starts \D2DATA\REGCARD.EXE on the disc
rem at EVERY launch and waits for it, and the card fills the screen unless
rem [Registration Counters] "Times Bypassed" in %windir%\EREGREG.INI is 3 or
rem more - the state a player reaches by dismissing it three times. REGCARD.EXE
rem reads it with GetPrivateProfileIntA and skips the card on "jae" 3. Closing
rem the card does NOT count as a bypass. Measured 2026-10-03 on .124: with the
rem counter at 3 the game went straight to its intro. Vista+ under UAC reads a
rem legacy program's %windir% INI from the VirtualStore, so that copy is set
rem too - not yet measured on a Win7 box. A whole new file is written: the
rem card's other section holds only its own empty form fields.
set "D2INI=%windir%\EREGREG.INI"
set "D2VS="
if defined LOCALAPPDATA set "D2VS=%LOCALAPPDATA%\VirtualStore\Windows"
set "D2REGOK="
findstr /i /r /c:"^Times Bypassed=[3-9]" "%D2INI%" >nul 2>&1 && set "D2REGOK=1"
if not defined D2REGOK >"%D2INI%" echo [Registration Counters]
if not defined D2REGOK >>"%D2INI%" echo Times Bypassed=3
if defined D2VS if not exist "%D2VS%\" md "%D2VS%" >nul 2>&1
set "D2VSOK="
if defined D2VS findstr /i /r /c:"^Times Bypassed=[3-9]" "%D2VS%\EREGREG.INI" >nul 2>&1 && set "D2VSOK=1"
if defined D2VS if not defined D2VSOK >"%D2VS%\EREGREG.INI" echo [Registration Counters]
if defined D2VS if not defined D2VSOK >>"%D2VS%\EREGREG.INI" echo Times Bypassed=3
rem ...and SAY so if neither copy took: the card then shows at every launch.
set "D2REGOK="
findstr /i /r /c:"^Times Bypassed=[3-9]" "%D2INI%" >nul 2>&1 && set "D2REGOK=1"
if defined D2VS findstr /i /r /c:"^Times Bypassed=[3-9]" "%D2VS%\EREGREG.INI" >nul 2>&1 && set "D2REGOK=1"
if not defined D2REGOK echo [%GTITLE%] REGISTRATION CARD NOT SUPPRESSED - could not write %D2INI% - the card will show at every launch
_note: The original Win95 build. D2X-Rebirth speaks UDP/IP natively and needs no disc, which is why this is the secondary shortcut. NOTE: MARKER was AUTORUN.INF once and matched a mounted StarCraft disc on .240, starting the game against the wrong disc - that is the origin of the 'marker must be unique to this disc' rule. PRELAUNCH 2026-10-03: sets the registration card's own "Times Bypassed" counter to 3 so REGCARD.EXE, which DESCENTW.EXE starts at every launch from the disc, exits without showing its full-screen form (tests/python/test_descent2_regcard.py).
